title: AGENTS.md
text: golem app R package — “fundamental unit reproducible R code”. Apply R package conventions: DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE, R/, tests/, etc. file doesn’t fit package structure must added .Rbuildignore via usethis::use_build_ignore("<name>"). R/ folder must stay flat — subfolders. Never edit NAMESPACE hand. Use devtools::document(). Development scripts go dev/, never R/. Data creation & manipulation go data-raw folder, files created usethis::use_data_raw() possible folders (limited ): renv, tools, doc, meta, rsconnect

text: project created using golem::create_golem(). Always use {golem} helpers — never create files manually: golem::add_module("name") — always pass with_test = TRUE golem::add_fct("name")— always pass with_test = TRUE golem::add_utils("name")— always pass with_test = TRUE Whenever can, update test files test modules fct & utils functions. aim 100% code coverage.

title: AGENTS.md
text: Use moduleServer() — NEVER callModule() (deprecated). Always namespace UI elements: ns <- NS(id). working module, check might missing ns UI. NEVER pass reactive() objects modules unless explicitly prompted .

title: AGENTS.md
text: ALWAYS use observeEvent() — NEVER use observe(). ALWAYS use reactiveValues() — NEVER use reactive() reactiveVal(). ALWAYS put reactive value inside reactive consumer. Correct: Bad: Prefer update*() functions (e.g. updateSelectInput()). Prefer JS-side show/hide server-side UI regeneration. Watch reactive cycles (updates B updates ). Break explicit conditions. ever need share data across module, either use global environment values can shared across shiny sessions, share reactiveValues() object modules. Always use reactiveValues() parsimony, make just needed shared one module . Don’t call reactiveValues r rv, find something meaningful like global_storage something like . pattern aim server-side, strict rule. Aim best working architecture follows rules.
code: local_rv <- reactiveValues(   a = NULL ) observeEvent(   input$a, {     local_rv$a <- input$a   } ) local_rv <- reactiveValues(   a = NULL ) local_rv$a <- input$a mod_<name>_server <- function(id) {   moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {     local_rv <- reactiveValues()      observeEvent(       input$btn,       {         local_rv$value <- compute_things(           input$btn         )       }     )      output$plot <- renderPlot({       local_rv$value     })   }) }

title: AGENTS.md
text: Add usethis::use_package("pkg") → goes Imports DESCRIPTION. Always use @importFrom top function. Whenever can, check new @importFrom required. Never depend {tidyverse} {devtools} — depend specific packages instead. optional (Suggested) packages, check availability requireNamespace("pkg", quietly = TRUE) rlang::check_installed("pkg"). Use Imports Depends. Depends R version requirements. Specify minimum versions >=, never exact versions ==.

title: AGENTS.md
text: exported functions must documented {roxygen2}. Enable markdown roxygen: add Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE) DESCRIPTION. Run devtools::document() {roxygen2} change — never edit .Rd files NAMESPACE hand. Use @noRd internal functions generate .Rd file. Use @inheritParams source_fn avoid duplicating parameter documentation. exported functions must least one @examples entry.

title: AGENTS.md
text: Environment config → golem-config.yml + get_golem_config("key") Runtime config → run_app(param = val) + golem::get_golem_options("param") NEVER store secrets/passwords config files.

title: AGENTS.md
text: Test files created usethis::use_test("name"). Tests hermetic: test_that() block sets data inline. Minimize top-level code outside test_that() blocks. Use withr::local_*() temporary state change (options, env vars, files). Write temporary files withr::local_tempfile() / withr::local_tempdir(). Never write home directory working directory. Store static test data tests/testthat/fixtures/; load readRDS(test_path("fixtures", "file.rds")). Prefer expect_error(..., class = "error_class") matching error messages. Use skip_on_cran() tests slow require network access. Test business logic outside reactive context whenever possible.

title: AGENTS.md
text: Add Dockerfile golem::add_dockerfile() platforms. Never hardcode environment-specific values — use golem-config.yml named environments (default, dev, production). Check app passes R CMD check deploying. Keep total package size 5 MB.

title: Combine reviewed batches into the final verified deliverables. — combine_reviewed
text: Walks every batch_*/ folder review_dir, merges paper's AI baseline reviewer's saved edits (falling back AI's values anything yet touched), writes two final workbooks. Every cell reviewer changed filled red.

title: Combine reviewed batches into the final verified deliverables. — combine_reviewed
code: combine_reviewed(   review_dir,   out,   extraction_out = "final_extraction_verified.xlsx",   qa_out = "qa_33items_verified.xlsx",   timestamp = FALSE )

title: Combine reviewed batches into the final verified deliverables. — combine_reviewed
text: review_dir Either parent folder holding batch_N/ folders (normal, whole-corpus combine), single batch_N/ folder directly (combine just one batch – also run_app's -app "Export batch output" button , always timestamped). Destination folder two output files. default purpose – see split_for_review's parameter . extraction_out, qa_out Output filenames (written ). timestamp TRUE, inserts timestamp filename's extension (e.g. final_extraction_verified_2026-10-07_1432.xlsx) instead overwriting every call. Default FALSE, since typically run , deliberately, final combine – repeatedly reviewing still progress (unlike app's export button, always timestamps).

what: Split AI extraction/QA output into per-reviewer batch folders. — split_for_review
title: Split AI extraction/QA output into per-reviewer batch folders. — split_for_review
text: Reads AI pipeline's two .xlsx deliverables (extraction + QA) source PDFs, writes one self-contained batch folder per reviewer, ready hand (see run_app).

title: Split AI extraction/QA output into per-reviewer batch folders. — split_for_review
code: split_for_review(   extraction,   qa,   papers_dir,   out,   manifest = NULL,   n_batches = 6 )

title: Split AI extraction/QA output into per-reviewer batch folders. — split_for_review
text: extraction Path extraction .xlsx (paper_id, pipeline, one column per extraction field, Flags). qa Path QA .xlsx (paper, pipeline, subitem, verdict, evidence). papers_dir Folder containing source PDFs. Destination folder batch_N/ subfolders. default purpose – data may live nowhere near wherever package installed, destination always explicit. manifest Optional path manifest.json mapping paper_id -> pdf_file (, optionally, doi) PDF filenames reliably match paper_id. Without , assumes "<paper_id>.pdf" papers_dir, every paper's DOI left blank. n_batches Number reviewer batches split (even split, overlap). Default 6.

title: CoReview 0.0.0.9000
text: Initial pre-CRAN version, restructured original Shiny app golem’s package/module conventions (mod_CoReview_main_ui()/_server()). Implemented “Save QA & continue”, batch export, status badges, change-count tracking, initial golem restructure yet carried . Fixed change-tracking (red highlighting) working : relied CSS class added via tagAppendAttributes() textAreaInput()/ selectInput(), places class wrapping <div>, actual <textarea>/<select> element. Field widgets now built raw tags, matching original app. Fixed startup crash batch folder supplied directly via run_app(batch_dir = ...) (reactive state read outside reactive consumer). Fixed Note QA Evidence fields incorrectly flagging “changed” edit, restored QA Evidence field’s read-, display-behaviour (AI’s supporting quote, never reviewer-edited). Added “Open system PDF viewer” per-paper DOI link, matching original app. Switching papers (via sidebar auto-advance completing sections) now always lands Extraction tab. exported pipeline column (AI model name) now access_type (open-access/paywalled) deliverables.
